I don't have money to buy fertilizer for beans when my maize plot needs it more, and beans grow well enough here without chemicals. I save my own seeds from last season, so I don't need to buy new ones. The rains will come soon enough, so there's no need to think about watering this small plot. My family can manage all the work ourselves—planting, weeding, and harvesting won't take too many days on just 0.08 hectares.
